notes.title: Hovership Havoc Update v1.3.0
notes.content:
Hovership Havoc update v1.3.0 Changelog

-Fixed bug with restarting game not resetting hovership temporary upgrades(thanks for letting me know iaspis!!)
-Added HP to each hovership at every level
-Added damage for each hovership at each level
-Tweaked hovership bullet hit boxes to better react to bullet size from the perspective

notes.title: Hovership Havoc Update v1.2.0
notes.content:
​New minor update just went live. This update includes the following:
-Fixed a few bugs with a few enemy meshes
-Tweaked difficulty of final boss a bit more
-Added support for GameSense lighting keyboard/mice/headsets from SteelSeries
-Various other small tweaks to difficulty and balancing

notes.title: Hovership Havoc Update v1.1.7
notes.content:
Small update with a very significant bug fix with the permanent progression!!

Changelog v.1.1.7
-fixed bug with permanent progression and having to sometimes reassign your hovership stats in the Edit Loadout screen
-fixed bug with laser line ability having basically no range to it
-fixed bug with player health and boss battles
-added graphic to Loading Screen to indicate to you which level you are on and what levels/bosses you will encounter next

Join our Discord if you have any other feedback or issues!
[url=https://discord.gg/vnA3yqs]https://discord.gg/vnA3yqs[/url]

notes.title: Small update v.1.1.3
notes.content:
Another small update just posted! Here are the tweaks:

-removed "Press any key" screen at main menu and tweaked save/load process to fix isolated issues with this
-tweaked particle effects for all hovership weapons to better reflect the range of the bullets
-slightly increased how long each enemy damage text is displayed for so it will be easier to see the numbers

Join our Discord if you have any other feedback or issues!
[url=https://discord.gg/vnA3yqs]https://discord.gg/vnA3yqs[/url]

notes.title: Small update v.1.1.0
notes.content:
Just posted another small update with a few noticeable but minor changes.

-fixed bug at the "Press any key or button screen" where it was only listening for certain keys. Should truly be listening for "any key" now.
-lowered volume of hovership hovering sound effect.
-fixed issue with mouse cursor where the cursor could leave the game and click somewhere else while using multiple monitors. It's now restricted to the game while playing top down levels.
-tweaked aiming plane a bit and should feel a bit more accurate to the aiming cursor while using the Pulse Cannon hovership.

Join our Discord if you have any other feedback or issues!
[url=https://discord.gg/vnA3yqs]https://discord.gg/vnA3yqs[/url]

notes.title: Small update v.1.0.9
notes.content:
I just posted a small update but it should be very noticable for anyone using a controller. It includes:

-Tweaked aiming hovership when using a controller. Now the hovership won't slowly rotate with momentum if you let go of the right joystick
-Add "Reset Save Data" button in the "Settings" screen at the main menu. This allows you to reset all your hovership stats


Thanks everyone for the feedback and don't forgot to join us on Discord if you would like to see anything else!!

[url=https://discord.gg/vnA3yqs]https://discord.gg/vnA3yqs[/url]
